watches.name: Sophene Noir
watches.description: In the Bajer Watches Sophene Noir, we carefully selected attributes from the brushed case to the scratch-resistant mineral glass to enhance the overall design. The Sophene Collection embraces sophisticated minimalism. Moreover, it brings a modern and contemporary design suited to a dynamic lifestyle. The Swiss-made timepiece at Bajer watches will stand out in a crowd for a meeting or a formal event. The C larity motif is what we picked for our Bajer Watches Sophene Noir. Let’s send a direct message to the world through Clarity. What you would like to clarify is totally up to you. However, we would love to be the visual representation of that expression. Please note that we are in this together; regardless of where you are in your journey to achieve Clarity, Go ahead and explore our other motifs in the wristband section. If you wish, please get an extra strap sold separately for your beautiful Bajer Watches Sophene Nero. We have two more motifs in overall five colors. watches.name: Corduene Choco
watches.description: Bajer Watches Corduene Choco provides the double-eyed chronograph with a matte dial finish. Corduene Chronograph lends a smart and sporty impression. However, we think every impression is the first impression. A Swiss-made chronograph quartz movement- all made in Switzerland- powers the Corduene Collection. We used premium materials, including break-resistant mineral glass, for our watches. Van, Hakkari, Sanli Urfa, and Mardin’s intricate architectural nuances are distinctive to the Kurdish regions in Turkey. Bajer took its colors and names from the Kurdish heritage and culture. We have picked the Resistance motif for our Special Limited Corduene Collection. Please, explore our wristband section and get an extra strap for your Corduene if you wish. Specification Movement: Caliber BAJ-3520D GILT Swiss Made Functions: Hours, Minutes, Small Seconds, Chronograph, 30 min/12 hour counter, Date Case Material: Stainless Steel Finishing: Brushed Case size: 40mm Case Thickness: 10,5mm Glass: Mineral, flat Dial: White matte with applied numbers and dots Hands Color: Silver (white inserts), Black Wristband Color: Chocolate- Dark brown Leather: Handcrafted 100% Italian Leather Strap, designed and mounted by a local, family-owned atelier in Italy.

watches.name: Basenia Nero
watches.description: Curated with traditional roman numerals, it contributes a timeless vintage look to any occasion. In the Bajer Watches Basenia Nero, we picked the Protection motif for you on the wristband. The Bajer Watches Protection motif honors the Kurdish woman who wove her wish to protect the household into her rug. You can carry your emotions on your wrist with our hand-crafted straps. You can tell a story of your own without using a single word. If you have your eye on a specific motif, take a look at the wristband section of our page to change up your style, featuring motif-clad wristbands sold separately. Explore our other motifs in the wristband section and get extra for your beautiful Bajer Watches Basenia Nero if you wish.
